summary: TotalEnergies SE filed a routine Form 6-K containing 16 exhibits covering September 2026 developments, including ongoing share buybacks (1,594,110 shares for EUR120.0m at a EUR75.28 weighted average from August 24-28 under the May 29, 2026 shareholder authorization), an executive committee appointment, an upstream entry into Namibia's PEL83 licence (Mopane discovery), Papua LNG FID progress, an Angola Block 17 discovery, sole ownership of the Grandpuits plastics recycling plant, a Mistral AI partnership, a GIP African infrastructure agreement, board reaffirmation of strategy, and a strategy presentation. This is a routine foreign private issuer current report, not a single special-situation event. Watch for cumulative buyback pace and any future tender or portfolio action.
